title: Yellow Punk Character Poses
description: Three cartoon illustrations of a female character with spiky yellow hair, wearing a black and yellow punk outfit with boots and wristbands. The left and right figures are in a low crouching pose, while the central figure is captured mid-jump with both fists raised above an explosive yellow starburst graphic on the ground.
prompt: Cartoon illustration of a fierce female punk rocker with wild spiky bright yellow hair, black headband, and matching black and yellow outfit with boots and wristbands. She is shown in three different poses against a solid gray background: crouching on the left, jumping powerfully in the center with fists raised above a yellow starburst explosion, and crouching on the right. Bold anime-influenced style with clean black outlines and vibrant yellow accents.
